The first time each target suffers damage before the start of your next turn, that damage becomes @DATA[key.typeLocal] @ICON[@DATA[key.type]]. This effect can trigger once for each target of the verse, separately.

Targets Gain: @EFFECT[pfu-menacing-tone-air], @EFFECT[pfu-menacing-tone-bolt], @EFFECT[pfu-menacing-tone-dark], @EFFECT[pfu-menacing-tone-earth], @EFFECT[pfu-menacing-tone-fire], @EFFECT[pfu-menacing-tone-ice], @EFFECT[pfu-menacing-tone-light], or @EFFECT[pfu-menacing-tone-physical]
